user.title: Realme Smart Scale
user.description: Choose the Realme scale from the discovered Bluetooth devices. If your scale is not listed, make sure it is awake (step on it once) or add its MAC address manually.

profile.title: First user
profile.description: Optionally pick an existing person from Home Assistant (the name is filled in for you), then confirm the profile the scale uses for the connection handshake and body-composition calculations. More users can be added later from the integration options.

data_description.date_of_birth: Your age is calculated automatically from this date.

abort.not_supported: This device does not look like a Realme Smart Scale.
abort.not_connectable: The Realme Smart Scale was discovered, but Home Assistant cannot connect to it. Make sure a connectable Bluetooth adapter or an active-connection proxy is in range of the scale.

error.dob_required: Please enter the user's date of birth.
error.dob_invalid: Enter a valid date of birth in the form YYYY-MM-DD (year 1900 or later).
error.dob_future: The date of birth cannot be in the future.

edit_user_form.title: Edit {user}
edit_user_form.description: The user's age is calculated automatically from their date of birth. If the profile has no date of birth yet, its stored age keeps being used until you add one.

data_description.date_of_birth: Your age is calculated automatically from this date.

remove_user.title: Remove user
remove_user.description: Pick the user to remove. This action cannot be undone.

remove_user_confirm.title: Remove {user}?
remove_user_confirm.description:
Removing this user will permanently delete:

• their stored measurements
• their Home Assistant sensors
• their Home Assistant device

This cannot be undone. Other users and the physical scale are not affected.

active_user.title: Scale handshake profile
active_user.description: This profile's sex / age / height is written into the Bluetooth handshake when the scale connects. It is NOT the person detected for a measurement - automatic identification decides that. Currently: {active}.

settings.title: Automatic identification
settings.description: Defaults used when a user does not set their own. A measurement is given to a user when its weight is inside their identification range (and, when both readings carry impedance, inside the impedance tolerance). A reading matching no one - or matching several people - stays unassigned; nothing is guessed. 0 disables an axis.

assign_pick.title: Assign measurement
assign_pick.description: {pending} measurement(s) waiting. Pick one and tell it which user it belongs to.

reassign_pick.title: Reassign measurement
reassign_pick.description: The {count} most recent measurements are listed with their current owner. Pick one and choose the user it actually belongs to - its body-composition values are recalculated for that user.
